name: application-12
title: Coding agent
description: A Kettlebrook coding agent: a task in the thread, the files it reads with their marks, a failing test whose output streams in the Tests tab, the fix written hunk by hunk in Diff, then the same output turning from failing to passing while the count rolls to 7 of 7, the checkout page before and after in Preview and a pull request that waits for Allow or Deny, over a footer with the branch, the tokens and the cost. Plug your agent into onSend, onApprove and onDeny.
